name: android-testing
description: Writes and fixes Android tests in a project whose test setup already exists: Compose UI tests with createComposeRule, "No compose hierarchies found", waitUntil and idling instead of sleeps, useUnmergedTree, "Method d in android.util.Log not mocked", Robolectric versus instrumented tests, Espresso, Hilt test rules and a custom runner, running one test with connectedDebugAndroidTest, Gradle Managed Devices, Orchestrator, and flaky instrumented tests. Use whenever editing or debugging code under src/test or src/androidTest that needs Android.
